{{Quote|But you have not come to see me; you have come for the artifact I managed to wrest from Tulak Hord before he died. Take the artifact, but be careful&mdash;I know not what it does. Only that betrayal follows it everywhere.|Aloysius Kallig|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''holocron''' created by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tulak Hord]] was one of a set of five [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] that he used to [[Conquest of the Dromund system|conquer]] the [[Dromund system]]. When Tulak Hord turned on his ally [[Aloysius Kallig]], Kallig managed to steal the holocron from Hord before his [[Death/Legends|death]], and it was stored in the [[Dark Temple]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, Kallig's [[Darth Nox|descendant]] retrieved the artifact from the temple, and [[Darth Zash]] tried to use it to recreate Hord's ritual.
